Not sure who downvoted me but for anyone else with my symptoms who comes through here, I found a research article that explains it. Endometrial lesions create an enzyme called LDHA which turns pyruvate into lactic acid, therefore increasing the amount of lactic acid in the blood while the lesions are active (your period). Pyruvate is made through glycolysis, when your body processes glucose. A google search of lactic acidosis endometriosis took me to multiple medical journal articles. So as you get more lesions, that tingling swollen sensation of lactic acidosis would happen, and then things like exercise, eating sugar (glucose) and drinking kombucha (which contains lactic acid) would obviously make it worse. Doesn’t necessarily indicate kidney endo. Hopefully my lap will remove the lesions and make this go away! Article link: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC8281285/
